candidates.description: Different premises for today's series. Each one complete.

ranking.description: Candidate indexes, funniest and most send-to-your-family first. Be honest: rank by how hard a real Indian 22-year-old would laugh and share it.

title.description: Short internal name, e.g. 'The Amazon parcel'

premise.description: One sentence: the situation and the punchline, used to avoid repeats

clock.description: Phone clock, 24h, fitting the story (03:40 for a late-night one)

who.description: them = the family member, me = you, react = an emoji reaction on their last message

text.description: The message exactly as typed. For react: one emoji.

pause.description: Optional extra seconds before this item, for comic timing (e.g. 1.2 before a deadpan 'Ok.')

caption.description: Optional end-card text, lowercase, 2-6 words. Usually not shown.
Instagram caption: one short reaction line, then a line that makes people send it to someone ('send this to the Didi in your family'). No hashtags.

youtubeTitle.description: Plain, curious title for YouTube Shorts
